entries.14405c3247954efe: An electronics trading company that purchases electronic components such as semiconductors and displays from manufacturers in Japan and overseas and sells them to electronic equipment manufacturers and others.
entries.1a8d2b4d2a3af015: It purchases and sells liquid crystal modules, organic EL, touch panels and others, and sells completed liquid crystal displays to customers such as commercial facilities. Main applications are office equipment, medical equipment and mobile devices. Revenue in the Japan segment for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥7,459 million.
entries.48004e8442a3b470: This category combines products that do not fall under the product categories listed above and products from new initiatives. Revenue in the Japan segment for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥281 million.
entries.7e166fd1ed33d469: It also handles display-related products such as LCD modules, but its revenue in the Overseas segment is small compared with semiconductor products.
entries.910ffd6b5d78a90c: This is the core product category of the Overseas segment. It handles memory, memory modules, ASSP, ASIC and other products. Revenue in the Overseas segment for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,732 million.
entries.abd20de4970835ca: This is the domestic reportable segment handled by the company. In addition to its head office in Chuo-ku, Tokyo, it has the Shizuoka Sales Department, Osaka Sales Department and Nagoya Sales Office, and sells products including semiconductor products, displays, system products, and battery & power equipment, mainly to domestic electronic equipment and industrial equipment manufacturers. In Asahi City, Chiba Prefecture, it holds land for a grid-connected energy storage facility. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥41,076 million, and the number of employees was 78 as of March 31, 2026.
entries.af21169f6e502d03: A field that sells battery-related products such as lithium-ion batteries and lead-acid batteries, power supplies and power supply modules, and power equipment. Power equipment is sold to customers for renewable energy, such as solar power generation. Revenue in the Japan segment for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,254 million.
entries.dae6633d076db684: The company's core field since its founding. It purchases and sells memory, memory modules, SSDs, ASSPs, ASICs, CPUs, GPUs, LEDs and others, and also handles foundry services based on customers' design data. Main applications are office equipment, automotive equipment and industrial equipment. Revenue in the Japan segment for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥24,370 million.
entries.e8f45087bec03dc0: A field whose strength lies in total proposals combining hardware, software and services. It sells inspection equipment, communication modules, Board (electronic circuit boards), servers and others, and also provides EMS, which entrusts product development and production. Revenue in the Japan segment for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥7,710 million.
entries.f6e02e089fe2e915: This is a reportable segment handled by the consolidated subsidiary Shinden Hong Kong Limited (Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China). It sells electronic components such as integrated circuits and liquid crystals, mainly to Japanese companies, and buys some products from the company or sells some products to the company. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,735 million.
